ticker.name: Western Asset Emerging Markets Debt Fund Inc.

business_summary: Western Asset Emerging Markets Debt Fund Inc. is an open ended fixed-income mutual fund launched and managed by Legg Mason Partners Fund Advisor, LLC. It is co-managed by Western Asset Management Company, Western Asset Management Company Limited and Western Asset Management Company Pte. Ltd. The fund invests in fixed income markets of emerging market countries across the globe. It seeks to invest in fixed income securities issued by governments, government-related entities, and corporations which are of any maturity and quality. The fund employs fundamental analysis along with a top-down security picking approach focusing on factors like currency, inflation and interest rate trends, growth rate forecasts, liquidity of markets for that country's debt, political outlook, tax environment to create its portfolio. It benchmarks the performance of its portfolio against the JPMorgan Emerging Markets Bond Index Global. The fund was formerly known as Salomon Brothers Emerging Markets Debt Fund Inc. Western Asset Emerging Markets Debt Fund Inc. was formed on December 1, 2003 and is domiciled in the United States.
business_summary_ko: Western Asset Emerging Markets Debt Fund Inc.는 Legg Mason Partners Fund Advisor, LLC가 출시하고 관리하는 개방형 고정 수입 뮤추얼 펀드입니다. Western Asset Management Company, Western Asset Management Company Limited 및 Western Asset Management Company Pte.가 공동 관리합니다. Ltd. 이 펀드는 전 세계 신흥 시장 국가의 채권 시장에 투자합니다. 정부, 정부 관련 기관, 기업이 발행한 성숙도와 품질이 모두 우수한 채권에 투자하려고 합니다. 이 펀드는 통화, 인플레이션 및 금리 추세, 성장률 예측, 해당 국가 부채 시장의 유동성, 정치적 전망, 조세 환경과 같은 요소에 초점을 맞춘 하향식 증권 선택 접근 방식과 함께 기본 분석을 사용하여 포트폴리오를 구성합니다. JPMorgan Emerging Markets Bond Index Global을 기준으로 포트폴리오 성과를 벤치마킹합니다. 이 펀드는 이전에 Salomon Brothers Emerging Markets Debt Fund Inc.로 알려졌습니다. Western Asset Emerging Markets Debt Fund Inc.는 2003년 12월 1일에 설립되었으며 미국에 주소를 두고 있습니다.
